server.provenance_limit: Released source and digest-pinned binary inspected independently; no reproducible-build attestation is claimed.

recording.response_encoding: Recursive {type,value} RESP frames; numeric double text is retained exactly.
recording.normalization: Only measured Query internal execution time values become <milliseconds>; graph keys are command placeholders. Cached execution, versions, stats, numeric payloads and RESP types are not normalized.
recording.topology_fixture: Protocol-specific assertion results; dynamic host ports, IPs, slot numbers and node IDs are checked live, not committed.

compact_tags.10: map with alternating key,tagged value entries
compact_tags.12: vector [RESP2 bulk decimal or RESP3 double elements]
compact_tags.14: date raw i64 midnight epoch seconds

invariants.header: Compact columns are [1,name], independently of the row value tag.
invariants.schema_rejection: [RESP error ERR invalid graph version,current_schema_version] before query execution.
invariants.graph_version_stat: Write version; not a schema token.
invariants.dictionaries: Operation-scoped and fetched on the same physical node/connection; graph recreation can reuse schema versions and IDs.
invariants.ask: ASKING permission is consumed by one command. Each metadata fetch also requires ASKING on an importing node.
invariants.parameters: CYPHER `identifier`=typed_literal prefix; nested map keys are identifiers, not JSON quoted strings.
invariants.parameter_key_subset: Nonempty keys without embedded backticks/control characters; quote with backticks.
invariants.string_escapes: Single-quoted literals accept escaped apostrophe, backslash, n, t, r, b, f and uXXXX.
invariants.timeout_ms: Canonical decimal integer 0..9223372036854775807, additionally bounded by positive TIMEOUT_MAX.

not_proven: Automatic failover during a graph operation
